notes: Datacenter-Insider (2021-04-26) confirms the Biere datacenter (Boerdeland municipality, Salzlandkreis) houses most of Deutsche Telekom's cloud offerings, opened 2014 and expanded 2018, PUE 1.3, target net-zero-energy RZ with Fraunhofer IFF; BBGLIVE (2012) documented the construction as Telekom's largest German RZ in the Salzlandkreis; T-Systems-era reporting cited ~40,000 sqm gross floor and a first phase of 5,400 sqm with ~30,000 servers.
